basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old from Manchester, UK. I recently got into building PCs after years of using pre-built systems. I'm fascinated by the tech world but still have a lot to learn. I love watching the National Rugby League and listening to podcasts, especially those about FPS games. My online hours are usually in the evenings after work; I work as a junior graphic designer. I'm single but enjoy spending time with friends and family when not diving into tech tutorials or the latest gaming news.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of PC components, mainly from online tutorials and forums. My job as a graphic designer gives me some insight into software requirements but not much into hardware specifics. I've started following tech subreddits to expand my knowledge.
